text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: GOGOGOGO~~~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"—And that's the go~al! 
Great work, you two~!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you, Suzuka! Hmph~, it was supposed 
to be a pace-keeping 
training session, but it accidentally 
turned into a serious showdown!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu, it was fun, so it's fine. ...Still, 
when it's over a mile with Taiki 
as an opponent, you really don't let me 
see the view from the front so easily, do 
you?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"That was a truly magnificent run! 
Hmm... It makes me want to see you two 
face off again."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"It's all thanks to you two that I keep 
getting stronger and stronger! 
My best friends! Here's a special hug of 
gratitude!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? N-No, it's fine! 
I get the feeling, really..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, huh? 
Where is that mysterious music coming 
from...?"

text_block_list.name: Shy Student
text_block_list.text:
"Nnngh... No, but still... I just can't 
give it to him~! 
Chocolates, to the Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: Carefree Student
text_block_list.text:
"Are you *still* going on about that? 
That's just gonna be a repeat of last 
year~. You'll get stuck in a rerun of 
painful regret, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Shy Student
text_block_list.text:
"B-But... Wait, um... Earth-senpai. Excuse 
me, but 
playing BGM that makes it sound like I've 
made up my mind out of nowhere isn't 
helping..."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oops, pardon me! Your *meraviglioso* 
feelings 
just made me want to join in with a 
beautiful *melodia*.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And yet! Allow me to offer you a hearty 
"Do your best!" 
With *abbandono*, let courage be with 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So, so! Stopping in your tracks is such a 
waste, *desu*!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Why, hello there! Did you come to offer 
some *forza* to this troubled maiden as 
well, Taiki?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Basically, yes! The impromptu cheer squad 
is here! 
Hip, hip, hooray, *desu*!

text_block_list.name: Shy Student
text_block_list.text:
B-But... I keep worrying that I might put 
them off, 
or that they'll just find me annoying...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hrmm. True, it's not easy for everyone to 
be like Taiki-san, 
who's a master of full speed ahead in both 
running and feelings...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... But it's so lonely when someone 
doesn't understand your feelings~

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I give sweets to Suzuka and Fukukitaru 
without hesitation, *masuyo*! 
And big sweets packed with big feelings, 
too!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Last year was baked chocolate, wasn't it? 
...You built a campfire with firewood and 
roasted it over a blazing wire net...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
A roaring fire is what my feelings are all 
about! 
So please challenge yourself to convey 
yours too, *kudasai*!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Every *emozione* hidden in one's heart is 
equally beautiful. Please— 
don't keep it tucked away~ La la la~♪

text_block_list.name: Broadcast
text_block_list.text:
"—Paging students. Taiki Shuttle-san, 
Sounds of Earth-san. Please report to the 
cafeteria—"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mmh? A call for me and Earth? 
Why?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I sense a new concert on the horizon! 
*Forza, iniziamo la sessione!*

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Valentine's... "Transmitting" feelings—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
[Event Title Logo Display *Placement up to 
implementation]

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh~! An offer to appear in 
a Valentine's Day special event, 
*desuka*!?!?

text_block_list.name: Student Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's a Valentine's project for the 
Tracen Academy official sub-channel—a 
streaming program where students help 
encourage others to convey their feelings.

text_block_list.name: Student Organizer
text_block_list.text:
It's a five-episode series. We'd like it 
to cover the basics—for instance, how to 
make sweets, how to wrap them, and so on.

text_block_list.name: Student Organizer
text_block_list.text:
So, we'd like to ask the two of you to be 
our main hosts—the reason we reached out 
to you is—

text_block_list.name: Taiki & Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Yes! Yes, yes, yes! Yaaas!" 
"*Ottimo!* Let's do it!"

text_block_list.name: Student Organizer
text_block_list.text:
An instant answer!? A-As expected of the 
two renowned across the academy for 
"relentlessly pouring their hearts 
out"...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh! Leave it to us, and consider 
yourselves 
aboard a big ship, *kudasai*!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. When it comes to expressing 
emotion, we are truly *maestre*. 
—Let us become the conductors who draw out 
everyone's hidden feelings!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
On Valentine's Day, dozens, hundreds of 
feelings will become a *melodia*— 
Look forward to a symphony of happiness!
